IGUI_GunsOfTien_LaserOnDesc: Switch the laser on. Aiming bonuses apply.
IGUI_GunsOfTien_LaserOffDesc: Switch the laser off. No aiming bonus while off.
IGUI_GunsOfTien_LaserEmpty: The laser's battery is empty. Take the laser off the gun and insert a new battery.
IGUI_GunsOfTien_AUGFoldForegripDesc: Fold the front grip forward under the barrel.
IGUI_GunsOfTien_AUGUnfoldForegripDesc: Swing the front grip down for a steadier hold.
